[Pedagogy audit v2 · New question to decide] For the type count gap (area-with-unit-change). Comparison score 36, between — and —: Same structure as the reference garden question: area, cm to m conversion with pronumerals, then an area product expression. Only the numbers and the direction of the changes differ.
Proposed question: A rectangular lawn is 15 m long and 8 m wide.
a) Find the area of the lawn. Show your working out.
b) The length is decreased by $x$ cm and the width is increased by $y$ cm. Find the new length and width of the lawn in metres.
c) Write an expression for the area of the new lawn.
(with a diagram)
Answers: a) $120\text{ m}^2$; b) Divide each centimetre change by $100$. Length: $(15-\frac{x}{100})\text{ m}$; width: $(8+\frac{y}{100})\text{ m}$.; c) Use $A=LW$: $(15-\frac{x}{100})(8+\frac{y}{100})\text{ m}^2$.
